en: Black‑and‑white view of a freestanding Orthodox church with multiple onion-like domes topped by crosses. The building is in Neo‑Byzantine style, with arched windows, decorative brickwork, and a large central dome surrounded by smaller domes. A fenced yard and gas‑style street lamps frame the front entrance; low town buildings are visible in the background. There is no printed caption or writing on the image side.
